description: Runtime integration of the deformable task (plan.md items 11-16): CLI flags in runtime/args.py (deform accepted in --task-ratio; lambda_pdice, p_pdice, lambda_smooth, smooth_order, integration_steps, decoder_widths, deform_decoder auto, deform_residual_affine, deform_group_size, gradient_checkpointing, overfit dice/fold thresholds, val pair cap), extra best checkpoint ckpt/best_deform in runtime/checkpoint.py, the third traced train step + deform diagnostics + val_deform validation + overfit criterion in runtime/run.py, deform validation PNGs in runtime/val_png.py, main.py wiring (DALI deform data, DeformValidationSet, synthetic/real overfit), and the synthetic overfit + three-task trace tests. Depends on FEAT-001 and FEAT-002. All linear defaults (best metric, overfit layout, logs, controls) unchanged.
steps: Read context.json, plan.md sections 0-1 and items 11-16, FEAT-001/FEAT-002 findings, then runtime/args.py, runtime/run.py (whole file), runtime/checkpoint.py, runtime/val_png.py, main.py, tests/test_trainer.py, tests/test_main.py, tests/test_runtime_infra.py, tests/test_val_png.py.

runtime/args.py (stay TF-free): accept deform in parse_task_ratio; add the flags of plan.md item 11 with defaults; model_config_from_args resolves --deform-decoder auto (True iff 'deform' in the ratio) and passes decoder_widths / integration_steps; train_config_from_args passes the new TrainConfig fields; restrict curriculum start validation and task_controls_from_args to linear tasks; error for --curriculum/--global-transform without any linear task; best-metric default: deform-only -> 'val_deform/pair_dice_loss', otherwise the existing linear rule over the linear tasks. Update the module docstring defaults list.

runtime/checkpoint.py: RunCheckpoint(..., extra_best=None) with per-name best variable and CheckpointManager (only created when given), maybe_save_best(value, name=None), latest_best_named(name); docstring.

runtime/run.py: TaskSchedule accepts deform; POSTPROCESS_SEED_OFFSET['deform'] = 303; TrainConfig fields of plan.md item 13; DEFORM_BEST_METRIC; resolve_best_metric update; DeformPostprocess for deform; _make_deform_step (input_signature from dali_loader.deform_output_signature with the uint8 label spec, trace counter, postprocess outside the tape, non-finite input guard, BN backup/restore, deform_loss, AMP handling as linear, static None filter, deform_diagnostics with the same diag_feat_rel_spread/diag_dead_frac keys + deform keys, finite gating); split_batch via dali_loader.output_count; fit logging per task; overfit_status() per task (linear rule unchanged, deform = window soft template Dice >= threshold and fold < max); deform validation (_val_deform_fn eval and train-mode variants, _val_deform_errors with argmax hard segs, pair cap, Jacobian, inverse consistency, centrality; cached identity baseline val_deform/pair_dice_identity; val_deform/pair_dice_loss), extra best saving, val/mean_pair_rms_mm over linear tasks only; deform PNG writer. Update the module docstring (three steps, None-grad table of plan.md section 0).
runtime/val_png.py: build_deform_panels, write_deform_png, deform_figure_title per plan.md item 14 (4 rows, mean column = template labels / mean J).

main.py: gradient_checkpointing passed to GroupRegLevelModel; overfit data for deform (synthetic_deform_group or real images+labels fixed group); DALI data module with deform_batch_size / deform_residual_affine; linear val sets only for linear tasks; DeformValidationSet.build for deform; extra_best ckpt/best_deform when deform + linear; overfit summary additions (deform_curve, deform_val_curve, window_deform, initial_val) leaving the linear layout unchanged; dry run with deform; docstring examples.

Tests: update tests/test_runtime_infra.py and tests/test_trainer.py deform NotImplementedError assertions to positive behaviour (plan.md section 1 item 6); add new-flag/default/best-metric/controls tests and RunCheckpoint extra_best tests to tests/test_runtime_infra.py; add TestDeformStep, TestThreeTasks (trace counts == 1 per task with rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2 on fixed groups, flips on, task order == TaskSchedule.draw, optimizer slots built once), deform validation/PNG/best/collapse tests to tests/test_trainer.py; deform PNG tests to tests/test_val_png.py; test_synthetic_deform_dry_run, test_deform_real_data_overfit_path, test_mixed_three_task_dry_run to tests/test_main.py.

New tests/test_deform_overfit.py: the synthetic overfit via main.main as in plan.md item 16 (narrow, N=4, level 4, <= 1500 steps, window soft template Dice >= 0.9 with fold < 0.1%, eval template Dice >= 0.85 and >= initial + 0.1, neg_jac_pct < 0.1, trace count 1). Run it standalone once with the same flags into a temp results dir, copy overfit_summary.json to .agents/tasks/milestone-6/overfit_summary_deform_narrow.json and the console log to .agents/tasks/milestone-6/overfit_deform_narrow.log; delete the temp results dir. Record steps-to-threshold, initial/final Dice, folding and median step time in findings.
acceptance_criteria: python -m unittest tests.test_runtime_infra tests.test_trainer tests.test_val_png tests.test_main tests.test_deform_overfit -v passes

Synthetic deform overfit reaches window soft template Dice >= 0.9 with folding < 0.1% within 1500 steps; eval-mode val_deform/template_dice and neg_jac_pct recorded

Linear-only runs: same best metric defaults, same overfit_summary layout, same logged keys, no control-file change (existing tests pass unchanged apart from the two deliberate deform assertion updates)

Final eval val (step 306): template 0.9712, pair 0.9503, neg_jac_pct 0.0, inv_consistency 0.050 mm (max 0.95 mm), centrality 9e-8 mm (raw 2.66 mm); train mode 0.9709 / 0.9505. Median step 1238 ms (test run 1132 ms), GPU peak 4.15-4.23 GB, standalone wall 456 s, test 397 s. Trace count {deform: 1}. The unittest run repeated it: step 306, eval 0.9705 / 0.9491.

TRACE COUNTS: TestThreeTasks (ratio rigid:1,affine:1,deform:2, flips on, 16 steps, seed with all three tasks): trace_counts == {rigid: 1, affine: 1, deform: 1}, optimizer variables 2 x trainable before and after (no later slots), n_vars_updated rigid = all - 2 - deform decoder, affine = all - deform decoder, deform = all - linear decoder. Deform validation fn traces once per (eval, train mode). TestDeformStep: deform steps leave every linear-decoder variable unchanged, a rigid step leaves every deform-decoder variable (incl. BN stats) unchanged.

DEVIATIONS / NOTES: (1) The overfit test passes --bn-momentum 0.9 and --overfit-dice-threshold 0.91 (test-only; defaults unchanged). With the defaults (BN momentum 0.99, threshold 0.9) the run stopped at step 189 with eval template / pair hard Dice 0.873 / 0.799 while train mode was 0.966 / 0.941: the eval-mode BN moving statistics lag the fixed group (kept as overfit_summary_deform_narrow_bn099.json / overfit_deform_narrow_bn099.log). Implication: watch val_deform vs val_deform_trainmode early in real deform runs; BN momentum may need lowering for short runs. The test asserts the plan's eval criteria (template >= 0.85 and >= identity + 0.1) plus pair >= identity + 0.1 and |eval - train mode| template < 0.02. (2) Budget: ~1.1-1.2 s per narrow deform step on the GTX 1080, so 1500 steps would exceed 15 min; the run stops at ~306. (3) Identity baseline keys: val_deform/pair_dice_identity and also val_deform/template_dice_identity (cached per set and group count). overfit_summary 'initial_val' = a validate() before fit (only when deform is trained, so linear-only layout is unchanged). (4) args resolves --deform-group-size None to --group-size in parse_args (config.json stores the value). --curriculum/--global-transform without a linear task -> parser error; with deform + linear, controls only for the linear tasks. --deform-decoder false with deform in the ratio -> parser error. (5) Overfit mode with --deform-residual-affine feeds identity T (the residual is a DALI augmentation). (6) Trainer.split_batch is now an instance method (uses cfg.deform_residual_affine); fit summary gains window_deform and best_window_soft_dice_tmpl (fit_summary.json, non-overfit runs). (7) Deform validation pair warps run in chunks of 16 pairs. (8) Local GPU note: with desktop apps holding ~1 GB of the 8 GB card, BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=6000 paged GPU memory and tests crawled; the verification ran with BGR_TF_GPU_LIMIT_MB=5000 (.agents/tasks/milestone-6/run_some.sh now honours an env override, default 6000). (9) Deform PNG: deform_step<step>.png, 4 rows (input, warped, labels tab20 with black background, det J RdBu [0, 2] with the 1-voxel border padded to 1), mean column = mean / label template / mean J; overfit mode also writes deform_step0000000.png from the initial validation.
